findings.session_summary: Initial session focused on establishing boundaries regarding household privacy and identifying the main barrier: travel costs adding to household expenses, leading to missed bus fare and walking. The student reported uncertainty about household budget details.
findings.primary_concern: Travel cost adds to other household expenses; uncertainty about household budget details.

tracked_details.detail: Agreed between-session task: List specific school costs to ask the support office about.

next_steps: Student to list specific school costs.

uncertainties: Exact dates of missed work are uncertain.
Whether a service is available remains uncertain.
findings.conclusion: The session established the main barrier (travel costs/uncertainty) and agreed on a preparatory task (listing school costs). No external support was delivered. The student reported that having an example made the first step clearer, but the wider problem remains unresolved. Evidence does not establish delivery of any external service.
